name: Liquorice + Cascara Sagrada + Belladona
indication_description:
This is indicated in-
  • Spermatorrhoea
  • Painful micturations
  • Nocturnal emission
  • Enuresis
  • Abnormal sensation and weakness of male organ
pharmacology_description: This is a very effective preparation of Liquorice (Glycyrrhiza glabra), Cascara sagrada (Rhamnus purshiana) and Belladonna (Atropa belladona) for nocturnal emission & spermatorrhoea.
dosage_description: 1 teaspoonful 2-3 times daily after meal or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place protect from light.
